caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a woman, labeled "Circus Wagon Figure" below the image. The figure is shown standing upright with her head turned slightly to her left. She wears a long, flowing dress with intricate folds and draping, and a cloak or shawl. Her left hand is crossed over her chest, grasping some of the fabric, while her right hand holds additional folds of her garment at her side. The texture of the wood, showing weathered grain, knots, and some cracks, is visible throughout the sculpture. The piece is colored in various shades of brown, beige, and gray, highlighting the worn, possibly painted wood. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the central figure. Ornamental details such as a patterned collar and possible headband at the top of her head are also present. At the bottom of the image, the text "CIRCUS WAGON FIGURE" is printed in capital letters.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: Medieval Lady
